恋上你中文 www.book630.org
⚠️ 搜索必须登录（正文/目录/详情免登录）；请到书源登录界面登录或注册。
搜索限频20秒/次，书源已自动处理；如遇限频提示等待20秒即可。
目录前100章在详情页，更多章节由目录分页自动翻页（每页100章）。
正文每章可能分2~3页(_N.html)，书源自动拼接。

loginCheckJs: (function(){var u=String(result.url()||'');var b=String(result.body()||'');if(u.indexOf('login.html')>=0||(b.indexOf('会员登录')>=0&&b.indexOf('user_code')>=0)){throw new Error('🔒 搜索需要登录：请到书源登录界面登录后再搜索（书架/正文无需登录）');}if(b.indexOf('搜索间隔')>=0){var m=b.match(/【(\d+)】秒，请于\s*([\d:]+)/);throw new Error('⏳ 站点搜索限频：'+(m?('间隔'+m[1]+'秒，请于 '+m[2]+' 后再搜'):'请约20秒后再试')+'！');}return result;})()
loginUi: [{"name": "帐号", "type": "text"}, {"name": "密码", "type": "password"}, {"name": "登录", "type": "button", "action": "login()"}, {"name": "注册帐号", "type": "text", "hint": "字母加数字3-15字"}, {"name": "注册密码", "type": "password"}, {"name": "手机号", "type": "text", "default": "13800001234"}, {"name": "注 册", "type": "button", "action": "register()"}, {"name": "检查登录状态", "type": "button", "action": "checkLogin()"}]

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var d=(typeof result.select==='function')?result:Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result));var el=d.select('#txt');if(el.size()==0){return '⚠️ 正文获取失败，请刷新重试';}var ps=el.first().select('p');var sb=[];for(var i=0;i<ps.size();i++){sb.push(String(ps.get(i).text()));}return sb.join('\n');})()
ruleContent.nextContentUrl: @js:(function(){var d=(typeof result.select==='function')?result:Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result));var m=String(baseUrl).match(/_(\d+)\.html$/);var cur=m?parseInt(m[1],10):0;var nxt=cur+1;var as=d.select('div.chapter-page-btn a');for(var i=0;i<as.size();i++){var a=as.get(i);if(String(a.text()).indexOf('下章')>=0){var h=a.attr('href');if(new RegExp('_'+nxt+'\\.html$').test(h)){return h;}}}return '';})()

ruleExplore.author: @js:result.select('span.s4').text()
ruleExplore.bookList: @js:(function(){var d=(typeof result.select==='function')?result:Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result));var ul=d.select('ul.sort_list').first();if(ul==null){throw new Error('⚠️ 列表解析失败');}return ul.select('li');})()
ruleExplore.name: @js:result.select('span.s2 a').text()

ruleSearch.author: @js:String(result.select('span.s5').text()).replace(/^\s+/, '')
ruleSearch.bookList: @js:(function(){var d=(typeof result.select==='function')?result:Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result));if(String(d.text()).indexOf('会员登录')>=0&&d.select('#user_code').size()>0){throw new Error('🔒 搜索需要登录：请到书源登录界面登录后再搜索');}var ul=d.select('ul.sort_list').first();if(ul==null){throw new Error('⚠️ 搜索结果异常：未找到结果列表');}var t=String(ul.text());if(t.indexOf('搜索间隔')>=0){var m=t.match(/【(\d+)】秒，请于\s*([\d:]+)/);throw new Error('⏳ 站点搜索限频：'+(m?('间隔'+m[1]+'秒，请于 '+m[2]+' 后再搜'):'请约20秒后再试')+'！');}return ul.select('li');})()
ruleSearch.name: @js:result.select('span.s2 a').text()

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:(function(){var d=(typeof result.select==='function')?result:Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result));var us=d.select('ul.chapter-list');if(us.size()==0){throw new Error('⚠️ 目录获取失败：未找到章节列表');}return us.get(us.size()-1).select('li');})()
ruleToc.nextTocUrl: @js:(function(){var d=(typeof result.select==='function')?result:Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result));var sel=d.select('div.page_num select');if(sel.size()>0){var opts=sel.first().select('option');for(var i=0;i<opts.size();i++){if(opts.get(i).hasAttr('selected')){if(i+1<opts.size()){return opts.get(i+1).attr('value');}return '';}}return '';}var as=d.select('ul.btn-group a');for(var j=0;j<as.size();j++){if(String(as.get(j).text()).indexOf('章节目录')>=0){return as.get(j).attr('href');}}return '';})()
